card.text: Explore Atlas with Cassini imagery, mapped radial height and its measured irregular shape.

introduction.text: Atlas travels just outside Saturn’s A ring. Its rounded central body and wide equatorial ridge give it a striking saucer shape. Cassini’s closest flyby in 2017 revealed the ridge in detail.

normal.title: ISS mosaic
normal.summary: Photographs are mapped onto the measured shape. Shadows and unreliable samples are withheld; the gray grid marks gaps.

elevation.title: Shape-derived radial height
elevation.summary: Height relative to a 15.1 km sphere, from the Cassini shape model. Accuracy varies by region.
